record.question: The state having the largest area of forest cover in India is:
record.explanation: Answer B: Madhya Pradesh. India State of Forest Report identifies Madhya Pradesh as having the largest forest cover area. Reference: https://fsi.nic.in/forest-report-2023. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: LDC MPSC Paper-I, February 2025 examination; current affairs interpreted as of paper date.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
